name: a-venv-inside-an-app-bundle-is-refused
find: owner = next((part for part in Path(base).parts if part.endswith(".app")), None)
replace: owner = next((part for part in Path(base).parts if part.endswith(".never")), None)
breaks: a virtualenv built on the Python inside another application stops being reported, so that application's update schedule silently owns the generation pipeline. That is #656: the venv ran on Xcode.app's Python 3.9 and nothing said so
